retraction.reason: Retracted in M44b, class B, and with a second reason beside it. What the item describes is twenty-two years of policy under several headings, not an event, and a record dated 1930 that runs to 1952 cannot take an edge that means anything at either end. Its nearest neighbours here are the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact and the Katyn massacre, at two hops and at none. Withdrawn as a topic rather than an event, and for reach.
